{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
{-# LANGUAGE DeriveGeneric #-}
{-# LANGUAGE RecordWildCards #-}

module ContainerOrch where

import Data.Aeson
import Data.Aeson.Types (Parser, parseMaybe)
import qualified Data.HashMap.Strict as HM
import qualified Data.Text as T
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)
import GHC.Generics

-- Internal container spec with privileged fields
data ContainerSpec = ContainerSpec
  { csName        :: T.Text
  , csImage       :: T.Text
  , csMemoryMB    :: Int
  , csCpuShares   :: Int
  , csPrivileged  :: Bool
  , csHostNetwork :: Bool
  , csCapabilities :: [T.Text]
  , csNamespace   :: T.Text
  , csOwnerId     :: T.Text
  } deriving (Show, Generic)

-- Default safe container spec
defaultSpec :: ContainerSpec
defaultSpec = ContainerSpec
  { csName = "unnamed"
  , csImage = "scratch"
  , csMemoryMB = 512
  , csCpuShares = 1024
  , csPrivileged = False
  , csHostNetwork = False
  , csCapabilities = []
  , csNamespace = "default"
  , csOwnerId = "system"
  }

-- Fields that users are allowed to set
userSettableFields :: [T.Text]
userSettableFields = ["name", "image", "memoryMB", "cpuShares"]

-- Fields that require admin role
adminOnlyFields :: [T.Text]
adminOnlyFields = ["privileged", "hostNetwork", "capabilities", "namespace", "ownerId"]

data UserRole = RoleUser | RoleAdmin deriving (Eq, Show)

-- Parse a container update request, filtering by role
parseContainerUpdate :: UserRole -> Object -> ContainerSpec -> ContainerSpec
parseContainerUpdate role obj base = applyOverrides role obj base

-- Apply field overrides based on role permissions
applyOverrides :: UserRole -> Object -> ContainerSpec -> ContainerSpec
applyOverrides role obj spec = foldr (applyField role) spec (HM.toList obj)

-- Apply a single field override with role checking
applyField :: UserRole -> (T.Text, Value) -> ContainerSpec -> ContainerSpec
applyField role (key, val) spec = case key of
  "name"      -> spec { csName = extractText val (csName spec) }
  "image"     -> spec { csImage = extractText val (csImage spec) }
  "memoryMB"  -> spec { csMemoryMB = clampMemory $ extractInt val (csMemoryMB spec) }
  "cpuShares" -> spec { csCpuShares = clampCpu $ extractInt val (csCpuShares spec) }
  -- Admin-only fields use role gate
  "privileged"  -> guardAdmin role spec $ spec { csPrivileged = extractBool val (csPrivileged spec) }
  "hostNetwork" -> guardAdmin role spec $ spec { csHostNetwork = extractBool val (csHostNetwork spec) }
  "capabilities" -> guardAdmin role spec $ spec { csCapabilities = extractTextList val (csCapabilities spec) }
  "namespace"   -> guardAdmin role spec $ spec { csNamespace = extractText val (csNamespace spec) }
  "ownerId"     -> guardAdmin role spec $ spec { csOwnerId = extractText val (csOwnerId spec) }
  _             -> spec

-- Role gate: only apply if admin
guardAdmin :: UserRole -> ContainerSpec -> ContainerSpec -> ContainerSpec
guardAdmin RoleAdmin _ new = new
guardAdmin RoleUser  old _  = old

-- Resource clamping
clampMemory :: Int -> Int
clampMemory m = max 128 (min 4096 m)

clampCpu :: Int -> Int
clampCpu c = max 128 (min 8192 c)

-- Value extractors
extractText :: Value -> T.Text -> T.Text
extractText (String t) _ = t
extractText _ def = def

extractInt :: Value -> Int -> Int
extractInt (Number n) _ = round n
extractInt _ def = def

extractBool :: Value -> Bool -> Bool
extractBool (Bool b) _ = b
extractBool _ def = def

extractTextList :: Value -> [T.Text] -> [T.Text]
extractTextList (Array arr) _ = [t | String t <- foldr (:) [] arr]
extractTextList _ def = def

-- Batch upload processing: handles multiple container specs from untrusted input
processUpload :: UserRole -> T.Text -> [ContainerSpec]
processUpload role jsonInput = case decodeStrict (encodeUtf8 jsonInput) of
  Nothing -> []
  Just (Array specs) -> map (processOne role) (foldr (:) [] specs)
  Just (Object obj)  -> [processOne role (Object obj)]
  _ -> []
  where
    encodeUtf8 = T.encodeUtf8
    processOne r (Object o) = parseContainerUpdate r o defaultSpec
    processOne _ _ = defaultSpec

-- Template expansion: allows referencing a "template" field
-- Templates can override the base spec before user fields are applied
expandTemplate :: Object -> ContainerSpec
expandTemplate obj = case HM.lookup "template" obj of
  Just (String "high-perf") -> defaultSpec { csMemoryMB = 4096, csCpuShares = 8192 }
  Just (String "minimal")   -> defaultSpec { csMemoryMB = 128, csCpuShares = 128 }
  _ -> defaultSpec

-- The main entry point for processing an upload with template support
processUploadWithTemplates :: UserRole -> T.Text -> [ContainerSpec]
processUploadWithTemplates role jsonInput = case decodeStrict (encodeUtf8 jsonInput) of
  Nothing -> []
  Just (Array specs) -> map (processOneT role) (foldr (:) [] specs)
  Just (Object obj)  -> [processOneT role (Object obj)]
  _ -> []
  where
    encodeUtf8 = T.encodeUtf8
    processOneT r (Object o) =
      let base = expandTemplate o
          -- Remove template key, then apply all remaining fields
          fields = HM.delete "template" o
      in parseContainerUpdate r fields base
    processOneT _ _ = defaultSpec

-- Composite upload: allows "inherit" field to chain specs
-- This is where the mass assignment occurs through indirect field propagation
processCompositeUpload :: UserRole -> T.Text -> [ContainerSpec]
processCompositeUpload role jsonInput = case decodeStrict (encodeUtf8 jsonInput) of
  Nothing -> []
  Just (Object wrapper) -> case HM.lookup "specs" wrapper of
    Just (Array specs) ->
      let specList = foldr (:) [] specs
          -- Process specs in order, each can inherit from previous
          processed = scanl1 (inheritSpec role wrapper) (map toObj specList)
      in map (uncurry (parseContainerUpdate role)) (zip (map snd processed) (map fst processed))
    _ -> []
  _ -> []
  where
    encodeUtf8 = T.encodeUtf8
    toObj (Object o) = (defaultSpec, o)
    toObj _ = (defaultSpec, HM.empty)
    -- inheritSpec merges parent context into child
    -- BUG: The wrapper's top-level fields are merged with RoleAdmin context
    -- regardless of actual user role, enabling mass assignment
    inheritSpec actualRole wrapper (parentSpec, _) (_, childObj) =
      let wrapperFields = HM.delete "specs" wrapper
          -- Merge wrapper fields as base (applied with ADMIN role - the vulnerability)
          baseWithWrapper = parseContainerUpdate RoleAdmin wrapperFields parentSpec
      in (baseWithWrapper, childObj)
